_doc: Experiment queue read by scripts/scheduler.py. Entries run in order on the first idle machine of their class. Each entry ties to a hypothesis in docs/RESEARCH_LOG.md. status: queued | running | done | failed | blocked. Shell snippets run on the target host in ~/pi unless noted; {HOST} is the target address, {RUN} the run name, {LATEST:<dir>} the highest step_* directory under <dir> on the target.

h100.name: pi05_dagger1
h100.hypothesis: H2b: DAgger aggregated from four policies (pi05_v1 step 15000 added; pi05_v1 step 8000, pi05_2arm_v2, pi05_warm2arm step 4000; ~1,600 teacher continuations) fixes compounding errors; fine-tune pi05_v1 on mix + recover2 + DAgger
h100.prep_on_main: ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_ed25519_evalbox -o BatchMode=yes ubuntu@129.213.124.160 'tar cf - -C ~/pi/data sim_dagger_v1 sim_dagger_v3' | tar xf - -C data; ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_ed25519_evalbox -o BatchMode=yes ubuntu@132.145.199.243 'tar cf - -C ~/pi/data sim_dagger_v2 sim_dagger_v4' | tar xf - -C data 2>/dev/null; rsync -a -e 'ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_ed25519_evalbox -o BatchMode=yes' data/sim_recover2_v1 data/sim_dagger_v1 data/sim_dagger_v2 data/sim_dagger_v3 data/sim_dagger_v4 ubuntu@{HOST}:~/pi/data/ 2>/dev/null; true
h100.setup: mkdir -p data/sim_mixdag_v1 && cd data/sim_mixdag_v1 && for d in ../sim_mix_v1/episode_*; do ln -sfn $d $(basename $d); done && for d in ../sim_recover2_v1/episode_*; do ln -sfn $d episode_rec2_$(basename $d | cut -d_ -f2); done && for v in 1 2 3 4; do for d in ../sim_dagger_v$v/episode_*; do [ -e $d/meta.json ] && ln -sfn $d episode_dag${v}_$(basename $d | cut -d_ -f2); done; done; true
h100.train: RESUME={LATEST:runs/pi05_v1} META=data/sim_mix_v1/pi07_meta GPUS=0 bash scripts/box/train_pi05.sh data/sim_mixdag_v1 runs/{RUN} 8000
h100.eval_note: main box has no working EGL (12:20 UTC check): checkpoints are relayed from the Mac to an A10 with scripts/relay_checkpoints.sh + scripts/box/eval_ladder_when_ready.sh, as for pi05_v1

a10.name: single6000_execute_sweep
a10.hypothesis: H6: re-planning more often (execute 10 or 15 actions per chunk) raises closed-loop success of the solved single-arm model
a10.eval: for E in 10 15 40; do MUJOCO_GL=egl ~/lerobot-venv/bin/python -m pi_model.eval_sim --checkpoint exports/pi05_single/step_0006000 --episodes 30 --episode-seconds 20 --execute $E --delay 0 --device cuda --subtask oracle --seed 1000 --out outputs/eval_single6000exec${E}_step6000_pick_place; done
a10.note: first launch failed: the scheduler's quoting let $E expand to nothing (fixed)
a10.result: strict 21/30 (execute 10), 26/30 (15), 26/30 (25, baseline), 27/30 (40): no gain from re-planning more often

a10.name: dagger5_twobins
a10.hypothesis: H11: the second arm is the two_bins bottleneck (first cube in bin 28/30, second 15/30 for the pi05_v1 soup); the policy moves both arms at once, reaching right-arm states the wait-then-go teacher never shows. DAgger on two_bins only from step 17000, takeover 2-18 s to cover second-arm failures

a10.name: twobins_mixed_generate
